sourceText: Strictly execute Story 6 through every remaining wave and complete each Story through DONE with genuine independent review and real 3x2 host assurance.
normalizedOutcome: An eligible independent topology critic can issue a signed current receipt, independently approved exclusions are attributable, and self-authored, ineligible, stale, tampered, partial, or unsupported cases are visibly rejected without claiming later-wave completion.
acceptanceClaim: Production CLI and lifecycle verification accept only a current fully bound receipt from the eligible independent critic with independently attributable exclusions, while every authority, freshness, tamper, and incomplete-basis mutation fails and restores cleanly.
